string.text: Antidote

The IP2 antitoxin is a complex drug comprising several antidotes, including metoclopramidum, pyridoxine, thiamine, riboxin and other pharmaceuticals. It puts agents into the bloodstream that break down protein-based poisons, along with absorbers for synthetic ones. It is not popular in the Zone -- most stalkers rely on a gas mask and a suit instead.

One dose %c[01,0,255,0]clears medicine intoxication completely%c[01,255,255,255], however bad it has become.

Doses left: %c[01,0,255,0] 3 %c[01,255,255,255]

Psy-blockade

A narcotic compound that damps runaway nerve impulses. It has a curious side effect: for a short while after taking it, all emotion simply drains away. In the Zone it is used against anomalous fields of raised psi activity; outside the Zone it never found a use.\n\nDuration: %c[01,0,255,0]3 minutes%c[01,255,255,255]. For that time psi damage is halved and a controller cannot take hold of your mind.
